6.3 follow-up, and a real contamination channel found by fixing my own bug. First implementation derived the project-key name from the corpus path and reported both trees clean; the derivation was wrong (the drive colon becomes a dash, giving a doubled prefix), so it matched nothing and returned a false all-clear. Matching against directories that actually exist instead shows ra-ship's key had a NON-EMPTY memory dir containing sandbox-probe.md, written 01:58 by the 2.6 closure probe. That matters: ask.py passes disallowedTools Write,Edit,NotebookEdit, so memory persistence does NOT go through those tools and disallowing them does not close the channel. One measurement session can therefore leave notes the next session on the same corpus reads. run_grid.py now MOVES anything it finds into a quarantine dir before and after every battery rather than merely checking, and records what it moved.
